Gewelltes Bic-Feuerzeughülle

https://makerworld.com/de/models/2882438-wavy-bic-lighter-case#profileId-3219450

Boost MeSmoking is bad.I wanted to create another lighter case, this time more comfy to hold along with a texture!

This model is designed to hold a standard size bic lighter.

If you enjoy my design please give me a boost!

Thank you!

-K0nur

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#D3C5A3)
